verdict.rationale: Recurly documents a free, self-serve sandbox for Recurly Engage, described as a secure, streamlined sandbox environment. However, it is framed around running internal engagement campaigns. There is no evidence of a sandbox for the core Subscriptions or billing API, or of documented isolation from production data. Missing for 10: a sandbox or test-site environment for the Subscriptions API, explicit separation from production data and credentials, test payment gateways or test cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Begin a fully self-serve, free sandbox of Recurly Engage to run internal customer engagement campaigns, starting with involuntary churn, using a secure, streamlined sandbox environment.
